name: OpenVoiceOS
description: An independent non-profit foundation building a community-driven, privacy-respecting open-source voice-AI platform. TigreGótico is a core contributor to OpenVoiceOS, and its founder serves on the foundation's board.

name: Alpha Cephei
description: A speech-recognition partnership bringing decades of automatic speech recognition (ASR) expertise — the team behind Vosk and Kaldi-based models — to our voice-model fine-tuning and dataset work.

name: ILENIA
description: A one-time subcontracted project for multilingual speech technology that TigreGótico contributed to, delivering speech-to-text and text-to-speech components across several languages.
